ramune.sum.seaglidebatteryswapupgrade.de: Adds a built-in battery storage which is used to automatically swap out depleted batteries for charged ones. Each upgrade adds <color=#01f8f8>+1 slot</color> to your battery storage. Seaglide compatible. Does stack.
ramune.sum.seaglideboostupgrade.name: Seaglide boost upgrade
ramune.sum.seaglideboostupgrade.desc: While active, enhances mobility at the cost of greatly increased battery usage. Seaglide compatible. Does not stack.
ramune.sum.seaglideefficiencyupgrade.des: Recycles heat by-product to minimize power inefficiencies. Seaglide compatible. Does stack.
ramune.sum.seaglidelightupgrade.name: Seaglide light upgrade
ramune.sum.seaglidelightupgrade.desc: Increases the power supplied to the Seaglide's lights, enhancing both range and area of illumination. Seaglide compatible. Does stack.
ramune.sum.seaglidenoisedampeningupgrade: Reduces the noise generated by the Seaglide, lowering the risk of hearing damage during extended use. Seaglide compatible. Does not stack.
ramune.sum.seaglidespeedupgrade.name: Seaglide speed upgrade
ramune.sum.seaglidespeedupgrade.desc: Increases maximum speed at the cost of increased battery usage. Seaglide compatible. Does stack.
ramune.sum.seaglidepowerglideupgrade.des: Transforms the Seaglide into an ultra high-speed propulsion device, increasing speed by 10x without any penalties. Seaglide compatible. Does not stack.
